works.title: Buckland’s Complete Book of Witchcraft
works.description: A self-study course in modern Wicca, laid out as a series of lessons. Buckland was an early figure in bringing Gardnerian Wicca to the United States, and the book reflects that initiatory-religion perspective rather than historical witchcraft.

editions.note: Second edition, revised and expanded; Practical Magick series.

works.title: Wicca
works.subtitle: A Guide for the Solitary Practitioner

editions.note: Llewellyn’s Practical Magick series. A revised 2004 edition is listed by some libraries.

works.title: Encyclopedia of 5,000 Spells

works.title: Seventy-Eight Degrees of Wisdom

editions.note: New edition with a new preface.

works.title: The Gnostic Gospels

editions.note: First published by Random House in 1979.
